response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS pd FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(pd) AS mean_pd FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_len) AS avg_length, AVG(r.pd) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(r.pd - m.mean_pd) AS avg_excess FROM r CROSS JOIN m WHERE r.pd > m.mean_pd
